fusions.name: First Syllable
fusions.desc: A spoken blow that deals 8 damage, up to 1.5 times that at maximum range. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Binding Verse
fusions.desc: Speaks a verse that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 5% of a boss or elite enemy's maximum health, and leaves each [Suppressed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Reach of the Word
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Final Clause
fusions.desc: When your mana runs out, you restore 12 mana. Once every 30 seconds.
